evidence.quote: [Setting up topic encryption with encrypted Amazon SQS queue subscription](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/sns-enable-encryption-for-topic-sqs-queue-subscriptions.md)

name: Data encryption
summary: Learn how to enable server-side encryption (SSE) for an Amazon SNS topic that is subscribed to an encrypted Amazon SQS queue, including creating and configuring KMS keys, setting up encrypted Amazon SNS topics, and verifying encrypted message delivery to Amazon SQS queues.
